Payout of 8 July is short ₹2,146.00.
The bank credited ₹1,71,373.44 against an expected ₹1,73,519.44. 17 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00001 of ₹2,146.00, raised 10 August. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00001 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00001 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
